verdict.rationale: Calendly's developer docs describe an Embed API for adding a scheduling page to your site or app. They offer inline, popup, or button-trigger styles "all with just a snippet of HTML", and give a concrete `Calendly.initInlineWidget({url: myLink})` initializer fed by the API's `scheduling_url`. A community report of a shop running a Calendly widget on its homepage independently confirms real-world embedding. Missing for 10: an explicit "floating" widget (docs say "button trigger" instead), and the actual popup/button-trigger snippet code, which the evidence does not show (only the inline initializer appears).
